Tutorials are grouped by subject but remain ordinary text files. Adding one means creating a new `.qmd` or `.md` file with a title and description; this page updates automatically.

New tutorials follow a common structure so that purpose, assumptions, procedure, verification, and troubleshooting are easy to locate. The structure is guidance rather than a rigid form: short references can stay short, while detailed guides can grow naturally.

## Subjects

- [Containers](containers/index.qmd) — Docker and service maintenance
- [Data management](data-management/index.qmd) — downloads, archives, and research datasets
- [Emacs](emacs/index.qmd) — Org mode and editor workflows
- [Physics](physics/index.qmd) — spectroscopy and small interactive references
- [Systems](system/index.qmd) — configuration and reproducible environments
